scripts.dev: mkdir -p logs && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend 2>&1 | tee logs/api.log" "npm run dev --prefix frontend 2>&1 | tee logs/web.log"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
